newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy to scale back, reopen bond issues.
newsitem.headline: Italy to scale back, reopen bond issues.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said on Friday it would offer 10-year BTPs and CCTs once a month in the third quarter of this year, against its usual practice of offering the paper twice a month.
It did not make clear whether the practice would be continued after the third quarter.

The Treasury also said that at its mid-October auction it would re-open a six-month BOT to be offered at the end of September and would re-open at the end of October three- and 12-month BOTs due to be issued for the first time in mid-October.
The Treasury said in a statement it expected the operation only to be applied once and for the issue to be closed after the second tranche.
